source_title: Fire breaks out at Bandra mall in Mumbai, no one hurt - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Mumbai: A fire broke out at a five-storey mall in Bandra West on Friday morning, civic officials said. No one was injured in the fire, which was doused after nearly three hours, said an official from the Mumbai Fire Brigade.A civic official said the fire broke out on the third floor of V N Sphere Mall on Linking Road, near Dhanraj Restaurant.The fire was reported at 6.02 am, following which the fire brigade deployed at least eight fire engines and other firefighting vehicles, the official said.He said the blaze was extinguished at 8.55 am.Besides firefighters, police, the electricity distribution company staff, a 108 ambulance service team and Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation ward employees were also mobilised to the spot, the official said.The cause of the fire and the extent of the damage are yet to be ascertained, the official said.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Mumbai | Silver Rate in Mumbai | Bank Holidays in Mumbai | Public Holidays in Mumbai | Mumbai AQI | Weather in Mumbai | Petrol Price in Mumbai | Diesel Price in Mumbai | CNG Price in Mumbai | LPG Price in MumbaiStay updated with the latest Mumbai news.
